summary: Frontend-only retest of the Laboratorio (Your Lab) first-entry scroll regression after removal of the legacy 500ms scrollIntoView('capo-source-choice') useEffect in PianoProduzioneAI.jsx. Tested on Desktop (1920x1080) and Mobile (390x844) with FRESH sessions (empty sessionStorage): admin login, Home scrolled to ~2700, then nav-tab-maestro. scrollY measured at 400/1000/1500/2500/3500ms. REGRESSION RESOLVED: all measurements = 0 on both viewports (previous iteration_118 showed jump to 2810 @1000ms). maestro-top-aggiungi visible in viewport (rect.top=305.5, bottom=373.5) on both. Second entry also stays at scrollY 0. Vertical order and CTA flow verified.

issues: Hero title 'Your Lab' / subtitle overlaps the busy background image (low contrast on the lighter shelf area) - readability could be improved with a stronger gradient overlay

critical_code_review_comments: React console error present on the Your Lab route: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... will cause a hydration error' (traced to PianoProduzioneAI / Maestro line ~232 subtree). Non-blocking but should be cleaned: <option> children must be plain text (e.g. flag emoji as text, not wrapped in <span>).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll regression fix verified on desktop and mobile with fresh sessions. Measurements: FIRST ENTRY scrollY {400:0,1000:0,1500:0,2500:0,3500:0} desktop and mobile; SECOND ENTRY identical. Vertical doc order: maestro-top-tools@281 < lab-wizard@551 < first capo-* (PianoProduzioneAI)@1783 -> correct. CTA 'Add a Recipe' (maestro-top-aggiungi) opens add-recipe view with maestro-back-btn visible and scrollY 0; back returns to tools with maestro-top-aggiungi visible and scrollY 0. No error elements on the page. Only remaining noise: React nesting/hydration warning for <span> inside <option>.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous jump to ~2810 was caused by the setTimeout(500ms) useEffect in PianoProduzioneAI.jsx calling capo-source-choice.scrollIntoView on first lab entry (guarded by sessionStorage 'mikilab_lab_scrolled'). That effect is now removed (only event-driven scrollIntoView handlers remain, for 'mikilab-generate-today' and pendingGenerate), and Maestro.jsx mount effect forces window.scrollTo(0,0) immediately + rAF + 80ms. Verified no delayed scroll occurs up to 3.5s.
